brief: A Goldman equities flow note for 1 Oct 2026. Rates: the curve bull-steepened after the PCE print and dovish Fed speak, October hike odds fell to 30% with ~3 hikes priced through YE'27, and the desk saw front-end buyers getting comfortable with fewer hikes; separately, France's fiscal plan drove cross-border flows and a flight to safety that pushed DXY up ~2 standard deviations. On the micro side, ACN (+16%) and SNPS (+13%, investor day) squeezed popular shorts and AI-at-risk names (GSTMTAIR +3.7%); even though most hedge funds wanted to add shorts here, the desk saw more buying than selling, with activity light (floor rated 4/10) and skews benign. Post-bell, NKE fell 6% as already-low expectations proved right: the top line missed but EPS was intact, and the FY guide was cut sharply, in line with the worst bear cases, leaving the stock at 26x P/E. Derivs flagged a choppy, credit-led morning selloff before a comeback; vol caught a bid on the move lower, customers added QQQ/IWM hedges, and a large MRVL straddle traded as the desk flagged nuclear names as underexposed. Ahead of tomorrow's payrolls (GS: +80k vs consensus +88k; unemployment 4.0%; AHE +0.2%), the S&P implied move is 67bps.
